name: Nomad Flagship
desc:
Makes this ship the flagship of the Flotilla, a migrant population that lives aboard your ships. The Flotilla is managed from the Manage button on the bottom bar, or from its Intel entry when that button is not shown.

Converts part of the ship's cargo capacity and quarters for the Flotilla. Both percentages are %s by default. Raises monthly supply upkeep by %s.

Ships with the Nomad Fleet Member hullmod add their Space and Berths to the Flotilla only while they are in the same fleet as the flagship. Only one ship can be the flagship. Can not be installed on frigates.
short: Makes this ship the flagship of the Flotilla.
